title: Basic English — Course 1, Semester 1 — Pilot Variant 01

tasks.prompt: Listening 1. Listen to Daniel. On which days does he have English lessons?
tasks.audioText: Hello, I'm Daniel. It's my first week at college. My English lesson is on Tuesday and Thursday mornings. I usually come by bus, but today my sister is driving me because it is raining. After classes, I want to join the robotics club. The first meeting is in Room 14 on Friday at three o'clock.

tasks.prompt: Listening 2. How is Daniel travelling to college today?

tasks.prompt: Reading 1. Read the text. My name is Lena and I am a first-year college student. I study engineering basics and enjoy learning how things work. My timetable is busy, but I plan my week on Sunday evening. I keep a notebook for new English words and write a short example next to each word. I want to improve my listening because I hope to take part in an international student project next year. Why does Lena keep a notebook?
options: To record new English words and examples

tasks.prompt: Reading 2. According to the text, what skill does Lena want to improve?
Choose the correct form: 'My classmates ___ in the English room now.'
Choose TWO correct questions in the Present Simple.
Complete the sentence with one word: 'A document that shows the days, times and rooms of your lessons is a ___.
Your teacher speaks too quickly. What is the most polite response?
Put these actions in a logical morning order, from the first action to the last.
Write 60–80 words introducing yourself as a college student. Include your course, one usual weekday activity, one English-learning habit and one goal for this academic year. Use complete sentences.
tasks.rubric: 8 points total: task completion and relevant details (0–2); understandable sentence structure and basic grammar (0–2); appropriate vocabulary (0–2); spelling, punctuation and paragraph organisation (0–2). Accept minor errors that do not prevent understanding.
